name: Trisha Calvarese
subject: What’s happening in Washington isn’t normal
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trisha 4 Colorado
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trisha-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trisha-dsg-email?]
I’m going to say what too many politicians won’t: What’s happening in Washington isn’t normal — and it’s hurting families here at home.
While Coloradans are worrying about grocery bills, healthcare costs, and whether they’ll ever be able to retire with dignity, our representative is busy chasing outrage, breaking rules, and embarrassing this district on a national stage.
Lauren Boebert calls it “fighting.” I call it failing — failing to show up for rural communities, to deliver for small businesses, and to understand how hard life has gotten for working families.
It’s time for a change. That’s why I’m running to defeat Lauren Boebert.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trisha-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trisha-dsg-email?]
I’m Trisha Calvarese. I grew up here, I went to public schools here, and when my parents were both battling cancer at the same time, I came home to take care of them.
I’ve spent my career fighting for working people — from representing 12.5 million union members to helping secure historic investments in American manufacturing, clean energy, and innovation that are creating good-paying jobs right here in Colorado.
I know what serious leadership looks like. And every day, Lauren Boebert chooses headlines over hard work and stunts over solutions.
Washington insiders are betting she can keep getting away with it. But they’re wrong. This race is winnable. It can flip the House and send a message that Colorado won’t tolerate another term of chaos, cruelty, and incompetence.
But only if we fight back — together. So if you’re ready for a hometown candidate who shows up, tells the truth, and puts working families first, I’m asking you to chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trisha-dsg-email?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trisha-dsg-email?]
Thanks for your support,
— Trisha

There are media reports that the Senate might give in to Trump's temper tantrum on social media and try to force a vote on this terrible bill, possibly even as a budget bill so they can use the parliamentary tactic of "reconciliation."
“ We have some clever wordsmiths, ” said Sen. John Kennedy (R-La.), when reporters pointed out to him that voting doesn't have anything to do with the budget.
RUSH $35 or more right now to kill the suppressive SAVE America Act, defend our right to vote, and stop opponents of voting rights from destroying our democracy >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031126_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project[https://voteractionproject.org/]
After the House recently passed the SAVE America Act (the new version of the SAVE Act), the Senate is all we have left to stop this suppressive legislation from becoming law ahead of the midterm elections , folks.
Defenders of voting rights know that non-citizen voting is already illegal, extremely rare, and that this bill is written in a way that could disenfranchise millions of eligible women across the country. That's not stopping Trump from social media tantrums, however:
Trump Truth Social post refusing to sign any other bills before the SAVE America Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031126_2&amount=35]
Opponents of voting rights in Congress -- and in the White House -- favor this new SAVE America Act because they know it could suppress millions of eligible voters, changing the composition of the electorate and potentially empowering them and their party for years to come.
Please, Team, support our efforts to hold the Senate accountable and stop this dangerous legislation with $35 or whatever you can and ensure millions of women's voices continue to be heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031126_2&amount=35]

We know the SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before November, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
The consequences of a bill like this passing would be simply catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=031126_2&amount=35]

# ICYMI. Nashville artist Trey Taylor plays our campaign event this Friday.

Hey Peter,Just a friendly reminder that this Friday’s concert is coming fast, and we still have room for you.March 13th at the 45th Parallel Distillery in New Richmond, 5:00 to 9:00 pm. Nashville recording artist Trey Taylor is coming to play, and I promise you this is going to be a night worth showing up for.

This district can be flipped. It starts with nights like this one.

| | | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Peter, it's Becca. **One of the most important parts of my job is hearing directly from people like you. When big decisions are being debated in Washington — especially decisions about war and peace — I want to know what you think.** Last week, I voted for a War Powers Resolution to force the Trump administration to come to Congress before continuing military action in Iran. The Iranian regime is brutal and oppressive. It sponsors terrorism across the region and has inflicted decades of suffering on its own people. **But condemning Iran does not give any president the authority to drag America into another war without Congress.** **Our Constitution is clear: Congress decides when our nation goes to war.** And yet the administration launched strikes without authorization. This is a decision that has already resulted in the tragic loss of American service members. **Before the situation escalates even further, I want to hear directly from you:** Who do you think should decide if America goes to war? | **[Congress — as required by the Constitution](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127147624/607095924/-416997556?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlODc0ZjUyMS1hOTFkLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FTAX6D0avjk_mNYhebMt9Ohjj86ZH93u5ja4QLySkdM=)**
---
**[The President — acting on his own authority](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127147625/607095925/-416997556?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlODc0ZjUyMS1hOTFkLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FTAX6D0avjk_mNYhebMt9Ohjj86ZH93u5ja4QLySkdM=)**
---
Americans have seen this playbook before. Endless wars in the Middle East that cost lives, drain taxpayer dollars, and distract from the urgent challenges families face here at home.
**I will continue doing everything I can to defend the Constitution, protect our troops, and make sure decisions about war and peace reflect the will of the American people.**
Thank you for sharing your thoughts today.
— Becca

subject: Let me explain using dog mushing:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
| In a moment, I’m going to ask you to [_**split a donation between Adam Schiff and my campaign for U.S. Senate to help us win this fight for our future.**_](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/5958?t=3&akid=9623%2E5257348%2EudgC7-) But first, let me explain why your support is so important using one of my favorite Alaska winter activities – _and our official state sport!_ [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/5958?t=4&akid=9623%2E5257348%2EudgC7-) When I was growing up, salmon fishing in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance. I still love to be outside. It reminds me of being a kid. But the abundance I remember doesn’t exist anymore. Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity. Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find. So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families. I’m tired of politicians in DC doing nothing to stop it. All while they profit off that very same system. That’s why I’m running to fight for Alaska’s future. Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again. But it won’t be a smooth course to the finish line. We’re racing against corporate donors and dark money groups who are going to spend big because they don’t want the rigged system to change. They’re the only ones this broken system is working for! _So here’s where the lessons I learned from dog mushing come in:_ **As long as we’re all pulling in the same direction, we can win this.** It’s all about the team, and I know we have an amazing grassroots movement that can take this on. Thousands of people have already pitched in to help us win this seat because they want to unrig the system in DC. Now, I’m hoping that today’s the day you can join them, because it all adds up when we chip in together. So I’m asking: [_**Split a donation of $10, or whatever you can, between my campaign and Adam Schiff to help us build on our grassroots momentum. Alaska’s Senate race will be one of the most competitive in the nation, so please chip in to help us keep moving.**_](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/5972?t=5&akid=9623%2E5257348%2EudgC7-) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [EXPRESS DONATE $10](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=q12026_abs_em_peltola._IDmYN&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20260311_PM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=9623%2E5257348%2EudgC7-)

name: Katie Porter
subject: Fuck Trump.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats
body:
#
**_Katie Porter spoke at the California Democratic Party Convention last month, please take a moment to read her remarks below and[then split a donation between State Democrats Committee and Katie’s campaign for governor.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/101155?refcode=em20260311-10173&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10173%2E614464%2EkcE-lV)_**
I’m Katie Porter. Some of you know me as the whiteboard lady who held CEOs and billionaires accountable in Congress.
So today, I wanna start with one simple, powerful message we all agree on.
Say it with me. Ready, 1 ... 2 ... 3...
**_Fuck Trump._**
Yeah, that’s right, Fuck Trump. Together, we’re going to kick Trump’s ass in November and stop him in his tracks.
I’ll stand up to Trump and his cronies again and again, just as I did in Congress—with or without my whiteboard. But this election for Governor is about far more than defeating Trump.
We **_KNOW_** what Trump is willing to do and how far he’s willing to go – he’s willing to kill people in the streets, to rip health care away, to ruthlessly attack our democracy.
But this governor’s race asks US — what are WE willing to do? What is CALIFORNIA willing to do for our democracy?
Who we elect as our next Governor is the biggest, most powerful statement we can make in 2026 about who Democrats are, in California, and nationally. About what we stand for, and about what we will do.
Let’s elect a bold leader who WILL DO big things – the things we have long fought for. When I’m your governor, I will deliver:
* Single payer health care,
* Less expensive housing,
* Free child care for all,
* Zero tuition charges at our UCs and CSUs,
* And, thousands of dollars back in families pockets, by eliminating California income tax for those earning less than $100,000.

Those are real affordability solutions!
For decades, we have fought for these ideas. We’ve organized. We’ve voted. We’ve pushed this party to be better.
I am running for Governor because I am WILLING and READY to get those things done!
But you know who is standing in our way? Billionaires and huge corporations that have far too much power in our country—and too much influence in Sacramento. I’ll take them DOWN and LIFT UP the working people of this state.
Look I understand, there’s a lot that makes me unique in this race—and some of that scares people. I’m the single mom of three kids, I push a grocery cart, fill my minivan with gas, and pay the bills. I understand what it’s like to watch expenses like utilities and insurance go up and dollars not stretch far enough, because I’ve experienced that too.
We’ve never had a governor like that in California. Heck, we’ve never had a governor in heels! And I think it’s about damn time.
My differences will make me a better Governor, better able to address the challenges Californians face.
California Democrats, our country is counting on us to lead the way—to send a message about our democracy—by rejecting billionaires and corporate-backed candidates—and picking as governor, the ONLY candidate who has NEVER taken a dime of corporate PAC money.
In this election, there is a very real possibility that Republicans could sneak two candidates into the runoff. We CANNOT let that happen.
But let’s aim higher than stopping them. Let’s seize the opportunity to elect someone who is WILLING to get big things done and READY to live up to our progressive ideals.
My campaign IS our Democratic values, powered by small donations from 70,000 people just like you. And how you campaign is how you serve. I humbly ask for your support, not to be Governor “Of” California, but to Govern FOR ALL Californians.
Thank you.
_And Fuck Trump._
Katie Porter is running for governor to stand up to Trump and lower costs for working families. We need your help to win. **[Please split $15 between Katie and State Democrats Committee today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/101155?refcode=em20260311-10173&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=15&t=2&akid=10173%2E614464%2EkcE-lV)**

clean_body: Katie Porter spoke at the California Democratic Party Convention last month, please take a moment to read her remarks below and I’m Katie Porter. Some of you know me as the whiteboard lady who held CEOs and billionaires accountable in Congress. So today, I wanna start with one simple, powerful message we all agree on. Say it with me. Ready, 1 ... 2 ... 3... Fuck Trump. Yeah, that’s right, Fuck Trump. Together, we’re going to kick Trump’s ass in November and stop him in his tracks. I’ll stand up to Trump and his cronies again and again, just as I did in Congress—with or without my whiteboard. But this election for Governor is about far more than defeating Trump. We KNOW what Trump is willing to do and how far he’s willing to go – he’s willing to kill people in the streets, to rip health care away, to ruthlessly attack our democracy. But this governor’s race asks US — what are WE willing to do? What is CALIFORNIA willing to do for our democracy? Who we elect as our next Governor is the biggest, most powerful statement we can make in 2026 about who Democrats are, in California, and nationally. About what we stand for, and about what we will do. Let’s elect a bold leader who WILL DO big things – the things we have long fought for. When I’m your governor, I will deliver: Single payer health care, Less expensive housing, Free child care for all, Zero tuition charges at our UCs and CSUs, And, thousands of dollars back in families pockets, by eliminating California income tax for those earning less than $100,000. Those are real affordability solutions! For decades, we have fought for these ideas. We’ve organized. We’ve voted. We’ve pushed this party to be better. I am running for Governor because I am WILLING and READY to get those things done! But you know who is standing in our way? Billionaires and huge corporations that have far too much power in our country—and too much influence in Sacramento. I’ll take them DOWN and LIFT UP the working people of this state. Look I understand, there’s a lot that makes me unique in this race—and some of that scares people. I’m the single mom of three kids, I push a grocery cart, fill my minivan with gas, and pay the bills. I understand what it’s like to watch expenses like utilities and insurance go up and dollars not stretch far enough, because I’ve experienced that too. We’ve never had a governor like that in California. Heck, we’ve never had a governor in heels! And I think it’s about damn time. My differences will make me a better Governor, better able to address the challenges Californians face. California Democrats, our country is counting on us to lead the way—to send a message about our democracy—by rejecting billionaires and corporate-backed candidates—and picking as governor, the ONLY candidate who has NEVER taken a dime of corporate PAC money. In this election, there is a very real possibility that Republicans could sneak two candidates into the runoff. We CANNOT let that happen. But let’s aim higher than stopping them. Let’s seize the opportunity to elect someone who is WILLING to get big things done and READY to live up to our progressive ideals. My campaign IS our Democratic values, powered by small donations from 70,000 people just like you. And how you campaign is how you serve. I humbly ask for your support, not to be Governor “Of” California, but to Govern FOR ALL Californians. Thank you. And Fuck Trump. Katie Porter is running for governor to stand up to Trump and lower costs for working families. We need your help to win. ** Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats.com). | | It's safe to say that Kristi Noem's tenure as Secretary of the Department of Homeland Security was a disaster. Kristi Noem used taxpayer dollars for her personal benefit. She funneled no-bid contracts to her friends. She helped oversee an alarming partnership between DHS and Silicon Valley that would use biometric data to spy on Americans. And she attempted to gaslight the public about the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti, rushing to label them "domestic terrorists" when we all saw video evidence of what happened. Kristi Noem's firing as head of the DHS last week was long overdue. But the grift, corruption, lying, and authoritarianism that marked her tenure are symptomatic of the _entire_ Trump administration — and Trump is going to keep pushing the same horrific **policies** that Noem was carrying out on his orders. The rot still runs deep. **I won't let Trump turn the page from the failures that he owns just as much as Noem.** I've no doubt Trump may cycle out more officials as the controversies and crimes pile up. **We owe it to the American people to bring all wrongdoing to light, hold public hearings, and when necessary, have trials.** Because what's happened for the past year under folks like Noem must _never_ be allowed to happen again. clean_body: I won't let Trump turn the page from the failures that he owns just as much as Noem. | | | | It's safe to say that Kristi Noem's tenure as Secretary of the Department of Homeland Security was a disaster. Kristi Noem used taxpayer dollars for her personal benefit. She funneled no-bid contracts to her friends. She helped oversee an alarming partnership between DHS and Silicon Valley that would use biometric data to spy on Americans. And she attempted to gaslight the public about the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti, rushing to label them "domestic terrorists" when we all saw video evidence of what happened. Kristi Noem's firing as head of the DHS last week was long overdue. But the grift, corruption, lying, and authoritarianism that marked her tenure are symptomatic of the entire Trump administration — and Trump is going to keep pushing the same horrific policies that Noem was carrying out on his orders. The rot still runs deep. I won't let Trump turn the page from the failures that he owns just as much as Noem. I've no doubt Trump may cycle out more officials as the controversies and crimes pile up. We owe it to the American people to bring all wrongdoing to light, hold public hearings, and when necessary, have trials. Because what's happened for the past year under folks like Noem must never be allowed to happen again. More soon, Ron P.S. name: Rose For Congress
subject: The Rose Doctrine: From Oil Wars to Resilient Communities
body:
The Rose Doctrine is simple: Real security comes from resilient communities powered by clean energy.

| | | | | [|
---](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=18ed624101&e=8c53948e4c)
| | | | | |
# The Rose Doctrine
---
| | Friend,
Right now the war on Iran is shaking the U.S. and world economy. Iran is defending itself and one of those weapons is disrupting oil shipments by blockading the Strait of Hormuz.
Roughly 20% of the world’s oil supply passes through the Strait and the effects of this blockade are already being felt. Families here in California feel it - at the gas pump, in rising prices, and across the economy.
Moments like this reveal something important: **Our energy system is too fragile.** For decades, America tried to protect itself with oil reserves and military bases around global supply routes. But when a crisis thousands of miles away can raise energy costs here at home, it’s clear we need a new approach.
That’s why I’m proposing what I call **The Rose Doctrine**.
The Rose Doctrine is simple: **Real security comes from resilient communities powered by clean energy.**
Instead of relying on oil shipped through volatile regions of the world, we can build local systems that keep our communities running — through solar, battery storage, and community microgrids.
But the Rose Doctrine goes even further. It’s also about building a **peace economy** that invests in the things people need most.
Imagine building thousands of **net-zero affordable homes** — powered by clean energy and designed to keep utility costs low for working families. Imagine those homes being built by **union workers earning living wages**. Those wages don’t disappear into corporate profits — they get spent at **local small businesses and Main Street shops** , strengthening the entire community.
That’s the kind of virtuous cycle we can create: good jobs, affordable housing, clean energy, and resilient communities.
I’ve written a blog post explaining how The Rose Doctrine — including **Clean Energy Resilience Zones** and net-zero housing — can help move us from a war economy toward a peace economy rooted in **People · Peace · Planet**.
[**Read the blog here**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=fcfb093542&e=8c53948e4c)

If you believe it’s time for bold ideas that move our country toward resilient communities, affordable housing, and a clean energy future, I hope you’ll help us bring this vision to Washington.
Our campaign is powered by people — not corporate PACs or fossil fuel money.**Chip in $3, $26, or whatever you can today:**

name: The Liberty Ledger
subject: Arizona governor vetoes bills aimed at reforming SNAP
body:

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1933, Franklin D. Roosevelt delivered the first of what became known as his "[fireside chats](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAUBeCnwQ4DF0Z_Coq_sZtttzQoF7kblAmQMb79xs2-wTan-ZJzkvP5nJ-OEh3bh9vRtpDnA8-asDUsM-5YNjzWK1MqmNBV9CGXBWcQMHChuITZO0rXrDtvAyKg6tDKcVRKCvlPd9EGMKMwDynA-EEBjNIMGKRBsayLRN2RvduEkiCFMFr0q5DDQ6uHDrAY45FpgZ5aLv1XpqNFDOnKbyz9mvcu2djaqzL1n8HEYDrPs49UWy7X7QymFqly7y5OB_8VBtPuyhq5BAZT8IVv9MbKA5Xa7sRKHvkaXeuK9a-TUqI6jEyLbXeUfpbbn-56W_gOAAD___GMfvo)," addressing the American people via radio broadcast directly from the White House. Yesterday, we asked you in our _Poll_ what subject you'd teach if you were a teacher, and hundreds of you wrote in with answers that went way beyond the list. Home economics, woodworking, car maintenance, budgeting, music, and religious studies all made strong showings in the replies. All excellent subjects! Thank you for sharing with us. ## Bam Breaks Modern NBA Scoring Record
Miami Heat center Bam Adebayo scored 83 points in a single historic NBA game, the most since Wilt Chamberlain's legendary 100-point performance in 1962. That beat the late Kobe Bryant's second-place record of 81 from 2006, which many considered untouchable. | | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?refcode=jtk299-fr-nd%3Famounts%3D5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1&akid=8120%2E400544%2EjpjHWu)

Good morning, friend.
I'm an early riser, always have been. If the sun's up, I'm up, ready to dive into my day. I’ve been sitting with a strong cup of coffee and reflecting — not just on the challenges of the past year, but on how difficult this year has already been. 2026 has brought continued violence, heartbreak, and uncertainty for so many communities, much of it fueled by the Trump administration’s reckless agenda and its deliberate efforts to sow fear and division. And now, Trump's illegal war has already claimed American lives and is driving up costs for families back home.
2025 was already a deeply challenging year for countless families. The administration’s economic “policies,” attacks on Medicaid and SNAP benefits, and ongoing threats to basic dignity and safety put so many people in impossible positions — and unfortunately, those harms have only continued into this year.
**In moments like these, leadership matters. That’s why I’m ready to step forward and serve as New Mexico’s next governor. At a moment when Washington is turning its back on working families, governors are often the last line of defense, protecting our rights, our healthcare, and our economic security. I’m running to make sure New Mexico has a governor who will always show up and fight for a better, more affordable future for all New Mexican families.**
**[But with everything that's at stake this year, for the future of New Mexico, and with Republicans already gearing up to try and buy this governor seat, I'm asking you to please make a donation to my campaign before midnight tonight. Our $30,000 mid-month goal is ambitious, but with your help, I know we can get there and give this team the best chance of winning — and delivering for New Mexicans — in November.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/6162?refcode=jtk299-fr-nd%3Famounts%3D5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=3&akid=8120%2E400544%2EjpjHWu)**
Thank you so much for being a part of my team, friend!
💛 Deb

I'm running because I'm a lifelong Michigander who has spent my career fighting for our families, our small businesses, and our manufacturing economy. Now, I'm ready to bring this fight to the Senate at this critical moment for Michigan and the country.
**Flipping the Senate blue is Democrats' best chance of keeping the Trump administration in check – and we simply can't do that if we lose here in Michigan.
**
MAGA Republicans know this too, and that's why they're laser-focused on this race. After spending nearly $80 million here last cycle, they're gearing up to spend even more this year, **putting this on track to be one of the most competitive – and expensive – races in the country.**
**[_That's why I urgently need your help, null._](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/15223?t=4&akid=2431%2E49239%2EanHfJX) My crucial mid-month deadline is three days away, and right now, we're pacing behind where we need to be.**
This is a really important moment for our grassroots campaign. This is our chance to show the strength of our movement to my opponent and his megadonors. **[_I hope I can count on your support._](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/15223?t=5&akid=2431%2E49239%2EanHfJX)**
**The bottom line is I can't run the most competitive campaign, win this seat, and take our fight for working families to the Senate if I don't have the resources to keep up with GOP spending and fight back against their attacks.
**

name: Nancy Mace
subject: Nancy Mace Helps Evacuate Americans from Iran Conflict
body:
Nancy Mace and Grey Bull Rescue Secure Emergency Evacuation Flight to bring 155 Americans home. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/nancymace/nancy-mace-helps-evacuate-americans-from-iran-conflict-10355374?e=ddc57b5ede)
---
| |
---
| |
**NANCY MACE HELPS EVACUATE 155 AMERICANS FROM IRAN CONFLICT ZONE**
_Mace and Grey Bull Rescue Secure Emergency Evacuation Flight_
---
|
---
---
| [Fox News Report](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=cc335da6fe&e=ddc57b5ede "Fox News Report")
---
| "**I left Israel last night on a rescue flight full of Americans.**

I originally went to the Middle East because there was a South Carolina family who was stranded. And because when your people are stranded in a war zone getting hit with missiles and rockets, the only answer worthy of the office - worthy of our country - is to get them out.

I have not slept. Not eaten much. And seen things. I am grateful for every exhausting moment of it.

There are those who govern from a distance - who weigh the optics or wait for the situation to resolve itself - and then there are those who get on a plane.

**I am the person who has always gotten on the plane.**

The family I traveled here for are safely home. But then I learned about more families. Hundreds of families. Thousands. Still stranded. Whom Grey Bull Rescue and others are helping.

Grey Bull has been evacuating Americans. This was their 808th mission. They got out 155 Americans yesterday, families with infants and students. They had the people but didn’t have the plane. I jumped in to get the plane (Thank you State Dept, Embassy Jordan, Israel and Greece).

Seeing this conflict firsthand reminded me what's at stake when the world becomes dangerous and leadership becomes a question of character, not convenience.

Tonight I am grateful. And I will never forget what I saw. What I learned. And the Americans who volunteered to help their fellow Americans, and those who are serving our nation patriotically tonight and always. **May God bless each and every one of you.** "

**\- Rep. Nancy Mace**
---
|
---
| **Grey Bull Rescue**
---
| "Last night, we evacuated yet another plane full of Americans trapped in Israel held at risk by Iranian missiles and drones. ** To date, in this war alone, we have rescued 591 Americans. **

Families. Children. Babies. People who have spent weeks in bomb shelters praying for their very lives, listening to warning sirens, feeling the ground shake from impacts, and watching missiles fly overhead in an indiscriminate war zone where Iranian missiles prey on anything.

**This is when Grey Bull Rescue goes to work.** Grey Bull has rescued THOUSANDS from Iranian and Iranian-backed terrorists since 7 Oct, then again in June 2025, and now again in this war.

Our team—made up of Special Operations and Intelligence Community veterans – who grew up in the most elite units and agencies in the U.S. arsenal - deploy to dangerous places to rescue and evacuate Americans to safety.
Today was our team’s 808th mission – over 8,700 lives saved....as of last night.

**With the help of Congresswoman Nancy Mace** and in close coordination with the U.S. State Department, just last night we evacuated 155 Americans out of an active war zone. Congresswoman Mace was fully embedded with our team, not to watch, but to work to save lives.

While a core value of Grey Bull Rescue is to be absolutely apolitical we are always PROUD AMERICANS to see our elected officials fighting for their constituents. Congresswoman Mace, saved lives this week.

Thank you as well to our colleagues at State Department. Specifically, U.S. Embassy Amman and U.S. Embassy Jerasulem.

We watched the Consular Staffs of both embassies work tirelessly to assist Americans to the best of their ability within the confines of policy limitations. While policies may be problematic, the consular officers work day and night for Americans."

**- Bryan Stern, Founder of Grey Bull Rescue**

Hi Everyone, **We are officially on the ballot!** We are incredibly thankful to YOU, our amazing volunteers, for making this possible. Thank you to the 93 volunteers who circulated petitions across the district, collecting an amazing 2,760 signatures. This was the first major milestone of the campaign, and it simply would not have happened without your time, energy, and commitment. Because of you, Alan will appear on the ballot and voters across the 14th District will have a real choice this May. Now the next phase of the campaign begins. Over the coming months, we'll be focused on reaching voters across the 14th Congressional District -- sharing Alan's message, building our grassroots team, and growing the momentum that you helped start. There will be many ways to stay involved, including:
* Knocking doors and talking with voters
* Making phone calls
* Hosting meet-and-greets
* Helping us grow our volunteer network by organizing in your community

We'll be sharing more volunteer opportunities very soon, and we hope you'll continue to be part of this growing movement. Thank you again for stepping up and helping us reach this important milestone. We are excited about what we're building together and grateful to have you on the team. Thank you! \--
Christina Proctor Deputy Campaign Manager 724-993-0329

# **Oil prices spike above $100 after Iran attacks six tankers in Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz**
Oil prices briefly spiked above $100 per barrel Thursday after Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) **[attacked six tankers in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz,](https://substack.com/redirect/187f3a61-889e-43e9-9784-68e93dea76ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with the two most recent attacks by explosive-laden boats hitting the Safesea Vishnu and Zefyros in Iraqi waters, killing at least one crew member and setting vessels ablaze. Brent crude futures jumped past $100 before falling back to around $96.50 per barrel as of 7 a.m. ET.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/187f3a61-889e-43e9-9784-68e93dea76ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** The IRGC warned that any vessel attempting to traverse the Strait of Hormuz--through which an estimated one-fifth of the world's oil passes--is subject to attack, with a spokesperson saying "expect oil at $200 per barrel. The price of oil depends on regional security, and you are the main source of insecurity in the region." The attacks came hours after President Trump ordered the release of 172 million barrels from the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve to combat gas prices that have surged an average of 60 cents per gallon since US-Israel joint attacks on Iran began Feb. 28.
* **The casualties:** The Thai-flagged Mayuree Naree was struck by "two projectiles of unknown origin" causing a fire and damaging the engine room, with "three crew members reported missing and believed to be trapped in the engine room" while the remaining 20 were safely evacuated to Oman. The Japan-flagged ONE Majesty and Marshall Islands-flagged Star Gwyneth also sustained damage from unknown projectiles, though all crew members on those vessels are safe. The IRGC released video of the burning Safesea Vishnu with a man shouting "Allah is the greatest! The destruction of an American tanker in the northern district of the Persian Gulf! I obey you Khamenei!"

subject: Urgent: Speak out to stop plans to clearcut Western Oregon forests!
body:
https://secure.ngpvan.com/DKj-oSwBG0eV3mQKZpaXHw2?contactdata=1A61yWzC8tzClo06Cc1gnKuu53BKlGvOutvEHi4zvn4icazDUYQvLDrL3aKapegjKr9PCVmMfrPi/DKrnya6gs1Tl6APAviq4TGDB/6FUG75ItRYpKRiyqhPrnOQLk0f [https://secure.ngpvan.com/DKj-oSwBG0eV3mQKZpaXHw2?contactdata=1A61yWzC8tzClo06Cc1gnKuu53BKlGvOutvEHi4zvn4icazDUYQvLDrL3aKapegjKr9PCVmMfrPi/DKrnya6gs1Tl6APAviq4TGDB/6FUG75ItRYpKRiyqhPrnOQLk0f]
Peter,
Oregon’s forests are under threat — and your voice is needed right now.
The Trump administration has announced plans to revise management of 2.5 million acres of public forests across western Oregon in order to dramatically increase logging levels.
If implemented, this proposal could open the door to widespread clearcutting across some of the most biologically rich forests in the Pacific Northwest. These forests provide habitat for species like coho salmon, marbled murrelets, and northern spotted owls, while also protecting clean drinking water, supporting recreation, and helping communities adapt to climate change.
The plan could:
* Return logging levels to those not seen since the 1960s
* Shrink protections for rivers and streams
* Reduce safeguards for mature and old-growth forests
* Prioritize timber production over wildlife, recreation, and clean water
Places many Oregonians know and love, including areas near the Molalla River, Marys Peak, Alsea Falls, and the Rogue River, could be impacted.
Right now, federal officials are accepting public comments on this proposal. This is one of the most important opportunities we have to push back.
Will you submit a comment today and tell decision-makers to protect our public forests, Peter? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/DKj-oSwBG0eV3mQKZpaXHw2]
Submit your comment [https://secure.ngpvan.com/DKj-oSwBG0eV3mQKZpaXHw2?contactdata=1A61yWzC8tzClo06Cc1gnKuu53BKlGvOutvEHi4zvn4icazDUYQvLDrL3aKapegjKr9PCVmMfrPi/DKrnya6gs1Tl6APAviq4TGDB/6FUG75ItRYpKRiyqhPrnOQLk0f]
Submit your comment and share why these forests matter to you, whether it’s a favorite hiking trail, wildlife habitat you care about, or the clean water they provide to communities across Oregon. The comment period ends on Monday, March 23rd.
Our forests belong to all of us. Together, we can make sure they are protected for future generations.
Thank you for speaking out,

clean_body: [] Peter, Oregon’s forests are under threat — and your voice is needed right now. The Trump administration has announced plans to revise management of 2.5 million acres of public forests across western Oregon in order to dramatically increase logging levels. If implemented, this proposal could open the door to widespread clearcutting across some of the most biologically rich forests in the Pacific Northwest. These forests provide habitat for species like coho salmon, marbled murrelets, and northern spotted owls, while also protecting clean drinking water, supporting recreation, and helping communities adapt to climate change. The plan could: Return logging levels to those not seen since the 1960s Shrink protections for rivers and streams Reduce safeguards for mature and old-growth forests Prioritize timber production over wildlife, recreation, and clean water Places many Oregonians know and love, including areas near the Molalla River, Marys Peak, Alsea Falls, and the Rogue River, could be impacted. Right now, federal officials are accepting public comments on this proposal. This is one of the most important opportunities we have to push back. Will you submit a comment today and tell decision-makers to protect our public forests, Peter? [] Submit your comment [] Submit your comment and share why these forests matter to you, whether it’s a favorite hiking trail, wildlife habitat you care about, or the clean water they provide to communities across Oregon. The comment period ends on Monday, March 23rd. Our forests belong to all of us. Together, we can make sure they are protected for future generations. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbsjjy&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbsjjy&__onlt=h)**

---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us. I believe you will find this book inspiring. Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life. In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans... ...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — it’s the message of FAITH! In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God. Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. And it’s happening. After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country. What we’re witnessing is not just growth —it’s revival. At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old. We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families. We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message. You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie. But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up. All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, “We’re not backing down.” This is what Charlie prayed for. I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too. None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith. Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God. I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible. Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. Peter,
Trump and his MAGA allies in Congress - including Lauren Boebert and other Colorado Republicans - are trying to force through one of the most dangerous pieces of voter suppression legislation since the Jim Crow era.
It's called the SAVE Act. And it's designed to make voting nearly impossible for millions of Americans.
The SAVE Act would require proof of citizenship to register to vote--sounds reasonable on the surface, right? Except it's a solution in search of a problem. Non-citizen voting is already illegal and virtually non-existent. Studies show it happens in a microscopic fraction of cases.
So why is Trump pushing this so hard?
Because requiring documentary proof of citizenship would disenfranchise millions of eligible American voters.
Elderly Americans who were born at home and never had birth certificates issued.
Low-income voters who can't afford the time or money to track down documents.
Native Americans born on reservations where birth records are incomplete.
Married women whose names changed and whose documents don't match.
This is voter suppression, plain and simple. And it all connects directly to Trump's Big Lie from 2020 - the same conspiracy theory that led to January 6th.
But there's a surefire way to stop this Jim Crow 2.0 legislation: fight back HARD during redistricting.
Even if MAGA passes the SAVE Act, even if they suppress millions of votes, even if they rig every rule in their favor - they can't win if Democrats flip enough seats to retake the House.
That's why Colorado Draws the Line was formed. That's why we're putting in the work.
Our ballot initiative will flip 3-4 congressional seats in Colorado--potentially including Boebert's--and help Democrats retake the House in 2026. And when we do, Jim Crow 2.0 legislation like the SAVE Act gets thrown in the trash where it belongs.
MAGA is trying to rig who can vote. We're fighting to rig who gets to suppress votes right out of office.

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks -- Donald Trump’s allies want him to declare a national “emergency,” all so he can take control of our elections .
A draft executive order circulating among MAGA elites would let him federalize election oversight, seize voting machines, and override state and local officials ahead of the 2026 midterms. Under the false banner of “election integrity,” these extremists are laying the groundwork to control how — and whether — our votes are counted.
Congress cannot sit back and wait for this draft to become reality. Lawmakers must move now to block any executive order that would federalize or seize control of our elections and hold immediate hearings to expose this scheme.
Tell Congress: Stop Trump’s emergency power grab. Block any executive order that would federalize or seize control of our elections >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-emergency-plot-to-take-over-elections/?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

Trump tried to overturn the 2020 election after he lost. Now his movement is pushing him to attempt something even more dangerous: rewriting the rules before ballots are cast.
The backlash has been so fierce that Trump is now denying knowledge of the scheme. But we’ve seen this before. On the campaign trail, he claimed he knew nothing about the extreme Project 2025 agenda. Now that same blueprint is shaping his second term.
If a president can declare an “emergency” to seize election infrastructure, no election in America is safe . That’s why we need Congress to act immediately, before this plot goes any further.

Hey folks,
I sat down with Congressman **Greg Casar** , and we talked about Trump's escalating war with Iran, the cover-up around the Epstein files, and why the fight for accountability is bigger than just one scandal. And toward the end, we got into the chaos around FEMA and what it means when disaster response becomes political.

* **00:09:28** - "The Epstein class": how billionaires operate in a different system than the rest of us--and why breaking that cycle is essential for a working-people politics.
* **00:12:37** - Kristi Noem's firing, the gutting of FEMA, and why disaster relief delays can cost lives--especially in communities hit by floods, tornadoes, and hurricanes.

**FINAL WEEK OF SESSION** This is the final week of the 2026 General Assembly session. While the work is not over, we were able to pass some bills to make Virginians' lives better. As our time comes to an end, I am grateful for all the wonderful advocates and constituents who made the trip to Richmond. Let's finish strong! You are able to check out all of our passed legislation in the tracker below.

**DEL. RASOUL BILL ADDRESSING SCREEN TIME ADDICTION PASSES** Our bill, HB1486, addresses screen time addictions by teaching our students the addictive potential of the time spent using electronic devices such as computers, cell phones, and other smart devices. This week, it passed through the General Assembly and is awaiting signature by the Governor!

| | , The Democratic primary for Texas Attorney General is headed to a runoff on **May 26** , with early voting **May 18 through May 22**. That means the next phase of this race begins right now. Runoff elections are different. They are shorter, faster, and decided by organization and determination. We can win this race, but it will take all of us working together over the next two and a half months. Here is my call to action. Please make a [**recurring monthly contribution through ActBlue for March, April, and May**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=619e43d8aa&e=5d8d80652b). To do this, simply choose an amount that is meaningful to you and remember to click 'Make it monthly' on ActBlue. If you do that, I promise your support will be meaningful to me and to this campaign. One of our big cases just took a big turn.
Last year, I told you we were suing Ticketmaster/Live Nation for running an illegal monopoly over the live entertainment industry.
When those two companies merged about 15 years ago, they gained control over the three big pieces of the industry: the venues, the artists, and the tickets.
If you control all three - _congrats!_ \- you're a monopoly.
Which is not technically against the law. What is against the law is using your monopoly power to drive out competition and exploit your customers' lack of choices to hike up prices.
Which is exactly what they did.
So after months of preparation, 40 state attorneys general and the U.S. Department of Justice went to trial together - one of the biggest antitrust cases in years.
Our first witness owned a venue and testified that Live Nation threatened to retaliate against him unless he accepted their terms. Our second witness said the same thing.
We were rolling.
Then, early Monday morning, USDOJ suddenly announced that they had privately negotiated a deal with Ticketmaster/Live Nation.
And they were bailing on the case. Mid-trial.
Forty attorneys general found out at the same time, and so did USDOJ's own _lead trial attorney_ \- the guy who had been in the courtroom presenting the case.
Which means this deal wasn't made in the courthouse - it was made in D.C.
Then USDOJ gave us 24 hours to join the deal.
Here was my answer:
_Absolutely not._ The deal is terrible. It's barely a slap on the wrist and does nothing to address the core issue: We need more competition in this market to bring down prices, and that means addressing Live Nation's total control over Ticketmaster.
I'm going to keep fighting for that outcome, and I expect the majority of AGs to do the same - including Republicans and Democrats.
Here's our **[video](https://substack.com/redirect/bbe99f4e-234b-4160-9e18-00301ae61f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** about this whole episode, and I'll update you soon.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/67a68e90-d295-463e-aaa8-0e00c47e2346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/bbe99f4e-234b-4160-9e18-00301ae61f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## **Back in court with FEMA**
Back in December, I told you we won a major lawsuit against FEMA.
It was $200 million for North Carolina, and the court made it clear FEMA had to pay.
But FEMA refused. They defied the court order.
So we took them back to court, and last week, we won again.
_" But c'mon, what's going to make them pay this time?"_
Good question. The court created a strict timeline: Within three weeks, FEMA has to show steps proving compliance. If they fail at any point, we'll be right back in front of the same judge.
The judge acknowledged FEMA is in a shutdown with a staffing shortage - and a recent leadership change with Kristi Noem's departure - but said that wasn't a defense. These funds are owed, and FEMA must pay.
Sometimes people ask, "What if the federal government just refuses to obey the court?"
I used to say, "That hasn't happened yet, but if it does, we'll take it seriously - and I bet the court will, too."
Well, now it has happened. We took it seriously, and so did the court.
I'll report back as soon as the money starts flowing.
## **166 brides & grooms**
Imagine how badly you have to screw up as a wedding photographer to get the attention of your state's attorney general.
I give you, Holly Christina Photography.
At least 166 couples are out approximately $750,000. This company sold wedding photo and video packages costing up to $7,000 by using high-pressure tactics, telling customers, "You're getting the last spot. Hurry up and book."
But it wasn't the last spot. They were often double- and triple-booking weddings on the same day.
So now we have couples who paid thousands and never got their photos - and others scrambling to find a new photographer a few weeks before their wedding, without the money they already paid.
We asked victims to contact our office and promptly got 166 complaints, with more coming in. We did a rapid investigation, found plenty of evidence, and now we're suing the company and its two owners. I'll let you know how it goes.
## **Lighthouse Fund**
Long email, quick request:
The Ticketmaster video above is exactly what I'd love for people across the state to see. The Lighthouse Fund exists for that purpose - so we don't have to wait until the next election to reach voters. The fund helps us push our videos out to independent voters, which is a great way to build support over time.

clean_body: Plus, FEMA and 166 brides & grooms | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Plus, FEMA and 166 brides & grooms | | | Mar 12 | | | | | | | | | | | | One of our big cases just took a big turn. Last year, I told you we were suing Ticketmaster/Live Nation for running an illegal monopoly over the live entertainment industry. When those two companies merged about 15 years ago, they gained control over the three big pieces of the industry: the venues, the artists, and the tickets. If you control all three - congrats! \- you're a monopoly. Which is not technically against the law. What is against the law is using your monopoly power to drive out competition and exploit your customers' lack of choices to hike up prices. Which is exactly what they did. So after months of preparation, 40 state attorneys general and the U.S. Department of Justice went to trial together - one of the biggest antitrust cases in years. Our first witness owned a venue and testified that Live Nation threatened to retaliate against him unless he accepted their terms. Our second witness said the same thing. We were rolling. Then, early Monday morning, USDOJ suddenly announced that they had privately negotiated a deal with Ticketmaster/Live Nation. And they were bailing on the case. Mid-trial. Forty attorneys general found out at the same time, and so did USDOJ's own lead trial attorney \- the guy who had been in the courtroom presenting the case. Which means this deal wasn't made in the courthouse - it was made in D.C. Then USDOJ gave us 24 hours to join the deal. Here was my answer: Absolutely not. The deal is terrible. It's barely a slap on the wrist and does nothing to address the core issue: We need more competition in this market to bring down prices, and that means addressing Live Nation's total control over Ticketmaster. I'm going to keep fighting for that outcome, and I expect the majority of AGs to do the same - including Republicans and Democrats. Here's our about this whole episode, and I'll update you soon. | | ---|---|--- Back in court with FEMA Back in December, I told you we won a major lawsuit against FEMA. It was $200 million for North Carolina, and the court made it clear FEMA had to pay. But FEMA refused. They defied the court order. So we took them back to court, and last week, we won again. " But c'mon, what's going to make them pay this time?" Good question. The court created a strict timeline: Within three weeks, FEMA has to show steps proving compliance. If they fail at any point, we'll be right back in front of the same judge. The judge acknowledged FEMA is in a shutdown with a staffing shortage - and a recent leadership change with Kristi Noem's departure - but said that wasn't a defense. These funds are owed, and FEMA must pay. Sometimes people ask, "What if the federal government just refuses to obey the court?" I used to say, "That hasn't happened yet, but if it does, we'll take it seriously - and I bet the court will, too." Well, now it has happened. We took it seriously, and so did the court. I'll report back as soon as the money starts flowing. 166 brides & grooms Imagine how badly you have to screw up as a wedding photographer to get the attention of your state's attorney general. I give you, Holly Christina Photography. At least 166 couples are out approximately $750,000. This company sold wedding photo and video packages costing up to $7,000 by using high-pressure tactics, telling customers, "You're getting the last spot. Hurry up and book." But it wasn't the last spot. They were often double- and triple-booking weddings on the same day. So now we have couples who paid thousands and never got their photos - and others scrambling to find a new photographer a few weeks before their wedding, without the money they already paid. We asked victims to contact our office and promptly got 166 complaints, with more coming in. We did a rapid investigation, found plenty of evidence, and now we're suing the company and its two owners. I'll let you know how it goes. name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: Republicans are trying to disenfranchise millions of voters
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOCELYN BENSON FOR GOVERNOR]
body:
[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
During his State of Union speech, Trump once again pressured Republicans
to pass the SAVE Act, a misleading unAmerican bill that would make it
harder for millions of American citizens to vote.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/3190?t=1001&akid=1556%2E181023%2EwW0bON ]The New York Times: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims
of Voter Fraud

The SAVE Act would disenfranchise millions of voters. It creates new
restrictions on registering to vote, including requiring people to
register using their birth certificate or U.S. passport and eliminating
the ability to register online or by mail.

This legislation could affect everyone, regardless of age, gender, or
background. It would disenfranchise active-duty military troops abroad,
married women whose names don’t match their birth certificates, and
roughly half of Americans who don’t own a U.S. passport.

The truth is, this isn’t about making our elections more secure. We know
that. Trump and Republicans have been peddling lies about election fraud
and stolen elections for years.

As Michigan’s Secretary of State, I’ve seen first-hand how these lies and
misinformation sow fear and put election workers and public servants in
harm's way. But, they want people to be
scared to show up to the polls. That’s how we let them win.

As governor, I will always stand up for our democracy, our voters, and our
election system. I’m not afraid to stand up to Trump and his gross federal
overreach into our elections.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/3190?t=1002&akid=1556%2E181023%2EwW0bON ]The last thing Michiganders need this November is a rubber-stamp for
the Trump agenda. If you’re with me in this fight for our democracy and
our elections, I hope you’ll join me with a contribution today:

name: CA Democratic Party
subject: Organizing in Action: Ready to organize? Start with this training!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the California Democratic Party | www
body:
cadem.org [cadem.org]
California Democrats,
Looking to learn more about how to most effectively engage with voters? We invite you to join our upcoming organizing trainings to get equipped with the skills, tools and strategies that'll help us flip seats and take back the House in November!
Whether you’re brand new or a long-time volunteer looking to sharpen your skills, these trainings will give you new insights and strategies for tracking voter engagement and having real, meaningful conversations with voters in the field.
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/875048/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/875048/]
Did you know that every month, our Organizing Team hosts a FREE virtual training for anyone looking to get in the fight to save our democracy?! Join us this coming Tuesday (3/17) at 6:00 PM to learn the ins and outs of PDI (Political Data Inc.), the tool we use to track voter contact in the field. Even if you're an experienced PDI user, you'll learn new major updates for the 2026 cycle, including core enhancements to mobile app functionality and door-to-door canvassing tools.
Register for our Monthly Training Series! [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/875048/]
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/890790/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/890790/]
Join us for a "Deep Dive on Deep Canvassing"—a proven technique for moving voters and building lasting engagement. There are four upcoming opportunities to join this training: Saturday 3/14 in Buena Park, Sunday 3/15 in Temecula, Saturday, 3/21 in Modesto or Saturday 4/11 in Fresno. We'll provide lunch and give you tools for having real, meaningful conversations with voters! Sign up by clicking the training you'd like to attend below:
March 14th Training in Buena Park [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/890790/]
March 15th Training in Temecula [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/897371/]
March 21st Training in Modesto [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/913371/]
April 11th Training in Fresno [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/911212/]
TAKE ACTION:
Every conversation we have with voters between now and Election Day matters. Whether you've never knocked a door in your life or you're a seasoned volunteer, there's a place for you on our team! Sign up below:
https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/ [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/]
Call voters! [https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/887949/]
https://www.mobilize.us/map/?lat=36.7378&lon=-119.7871&tag_ids=29029&zoom=5&nvep=&hmac=&emci=5c012296-53eb-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid= [https://www.mobilize.us/map/?lat=36.7378&lon=-119.7871&tag_ids=29029&zoom=5&nvep=&hmac=&emci=5c012296-53eb-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
Knock on doors! [https://www.mobilize.us/map/?lat=36.7378&lon=-119.7871&tag_ids=29029&zoom=5&nvep=&hmac=&emci=5c012296-53eb-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
Together with these tools, we have what it takes to flip seats and take back the House. Let's make it happen! I'll see you in the field.
- Helen Amelga
CADEM Organizing & Training Director

subject: Add your name: Tell Schumer & Jeffries to step up or step down
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Trump's disastrous, billion dollar a day war is spiraling out of control.
But instead of battling him at every turn, Senate Minority Leader Schumer
and House Minority Leader Jeffries are playing it safe, hoping outrage
will pass. This gutless wait-and-see approach is dangerous.

Bernie is showing what principled leadership looks like. He's calling
Trump's illegal war on Iran what it is – a violation of the Geneva
Conventions and a threat to every global institution that's kept us from
the brink. And now people across the country are speaking up, demanding
Schumer and Jeffries step up and confront these crimes head on.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36080?source=email-20260312&t=1011&akid=10375%2E5885482%2ELfMuAy ]Headline: Coalition demands Schumer, Jeffries step down over failure to
fight 'war-crazed' Trump

One thing is clear: if we don't fight back, Trump will continue to believe
he can bomb and bully with impunity – and that Congressional Democrats
will do nothing to stop him.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36080?source=email-20260312&t=1012&akid=10375%2E5885482%2ELfMuAy ]So let's fight back. Add your name right now: Demand Democratic leaders
Schumer and Jeffries resign – we need real leadership to stop war-crazed
Trump!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36080?source=email-20260312&t=1013&akid=10375%2E5885482%2ELfMuAy ]ADD YOUR NAME

The numbers don't lie: the majority of Americans oppose Trump's war on
Iran. But when he was pressed last week about handing Trump MORE Pentagon
funding for his attacks on Iran, Hakeem Jeffries shrugged it off, saying,
"We'll cross that bridge when we get to it."

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36080?source=email-20260312&t=1014&akid=10375%2E5885482%2ELfMuAy ]Headline: Jeffries declines to say whether he'll block Pentagon
funding: 'We'll cross that bridge when we get to it'

That's not leadership – that's political negligence, and it gives Trump
the greenlight for more bombing and more needless death.

These aren't abstract debates happening in Washington. Every dollar
Congress hands to the Pentagon is one less for health care, housing, and
schools. And every missile Trump fires unleashes chaos and death across
the Middle East.

Other progressive groups are standing up to demand leadership that
actually leads in the face of war crimes. Our Revolution was founded to
challenge this kind of failed leadership, and we're ready to act.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36080?source=email-20260312&t=1015&akid=10375%2E5885482%2ELfMuAy ]Add your name to call on Schumer and Jeffries to step up or step down
as Democratic leaders. Together let's build a Congress with the backbone
to stand up to Trump's war machine.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36080?source=email-20260312&t=1016&akid=10375%2E5885482%2ELfMuAy ]ADD YOUR NAME

When we organize, we win,

Our Revolution

Joining me is author Jeff Putnam Best known for his Cole Harper adventure novels. His books are written the way adventure novels should be written--raw, relentless, and packed with high-stakes action. His stories aren't about invincible superheroes or chosen ones with destiny on their side. They're about men like Cole Harper--flawed, cunning, and forced to fight their way out of impossible situations with nothing but grit, wits, and a well-worn .45.
As one critic exclaimed, "Jeff writes for readers who want danger, grit, and action that hits like a left hook. Inspired by the classic adventure fiction of the 1930s and '40s, Jeff brings back the lost art of men facing impossible odds, living by their wits, and fighting battles worth bleeding for." For more about Jeff and his books visit

Fellow Conservative,

I'm Adam Schwarze, _**a former Navy SEAL,**_ Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan. As a combat veteran who deployed nine times to defend our nation, putting my life on the line so families like yours could sleep safely, I'm writing to ask for your support in my run for U.S. Senate.

_****Please do me the personal favor of reading this note all the way to the end; I put a lot of time and effort into it.****_

Our neighborhoods aren't what they were when I grew up in the '80s and '90s.

Would you let your kids or grandkids play outside unsupervised for hours today? Those days feel like a distant memory now—but they shouldn’t be.

**Americans deserve communities where children can play without fear of criminal illegal immigrants or violent chaos fueled by weak policies put into place by radical Democrats.
**
**For his part, President Trump is delivering real progress:** strong borders, backing the blue, and decisive action against threats. And right now, we have a strong Republican majority in the Senate standing up to support him.

But maybe not for long...

Not only is President Trump working to make our homeland safer through his support for increased police presence and zero tolerance for criminal behavior, but he’s also taking the fight to our enemies abroad in a show of immense strength. **As you know, Trump is leading a bold effort to confront the terrorist regime in Iran—because real leaders don't back down from tyrants. As the Wall Street Journal recently reported, most Democrats oppose this effort and even seem to hope for failure. Only a few, like Sen. Fetterman, stand firm.**

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: The book Charlie left behind
body:
