Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbsqlz&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbsqlz&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbsqlz&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbsqlz&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.
But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.
As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC.
I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you.
I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great.

It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC. But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11. As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you. I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great. We're coming out of the most expensive election in American history. I mean that. Kamala Harris spent over a billion dollars against us. It took EVERY PENNY we had to get our story out there, expose her ultra-Liberal record, reach undecided voters, and win. So now we're forced to rebuild. The Democrat Machine is ALREADY crushing us in fundraising, ALREADY outspending us in key races, and ALREADY building the campaign infrastructure to decimate us in the Midterm Elections. At this point, the consequences of simply resting on our laurels would be unthinkable. So here's my final pitch to you: I understand that's ambitious. If my humble beginnings taught me anything, it's to never give up, never surrender, and never go down without a fight. That's why I'm partnering with Steve Scalise to help lay the critical groundwork we need to win. Regardless, it's an honor to fight alongside you. subject: A step forward for flooding recovery efforts

body:
Last winter, we faced historic and devastating levels of flooding.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127197015/607254524/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ODRjNmY4ZC0zOTFlLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mQCXbGk_UQqszwxueKP0Ti_EJOOcEHrFJVaOdwNeDCA=&emci=b09df056-d618-f111-a69a-000d3a1f0a97&emdi=884c6f8d-391e-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=9494239)
---

| | Last winter, we faced historic and devastating flooding in our communities. We need federal support to recover from the aftermath. For several months now, I have been pushing for more federal support to address the lasting effects of the historic flooding. Last week, the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) took an important step forward in this effort. **The SBA has made available low-interest federal disaster loans to Washington businesses impacted by severe flooding last December.** Businesses and nonprofits are eligible to apply for business physical disaster loans and economic injury disaster loans and may borrow up to $2 million to repair or replace disaster-damaged or destroyed real estate, machinery and equipment, inventory, and other business assets. Interest rates are as low as 4% for businesses, 3.625% for PNPs, and 2.875% for homeowners and renters with terms up to 30 years. These loans are an important step in the disaster relief process, and I will keep fighting for more funds to help families and businesses in Northwest Washington make a full recovery. The declaration covers Skagit, Snohomish, Island, Whatcom, and San Juan counties in Northwest Washington. More soon, _Rick_ |

clean_body: It’s been 12 days since Trump and Netanyahu kicked off their illegal war with Iran. | | | Peter, It’s been 12 days since Trump and Netanyahu kicked off their illegal war with Iran, and already: More than 1,300 Iranian civilians have been killed1 7 U.S. service members have been killed,2 with another 140 wounded3 Gas prices at home have skyrocketed And the conservative estimates of the cost for taxpayers is already over $17 billion4 This is what Sen. John Fetterman — along with the entire MAGA wing of Congress — proudly and unapologetically voted for when they failed to pass the War Powers Resolution. This war could last until September , according to some reports. And if the current rate holds, that means U.S. taxpayers would be spending well over $100 billion on a conflict that only a quarter of the country supports. 4 And the fact that less than 35% of Americans support such a war is proof of how deranged and out-of-touch these elected officials truly are.3 Meanwhile, Fetterman’s constituents in Pennsylvania are behind on rent payments and drowning in debt. Rather than addressing their material needs, he’s been celebrating the bombings on Fox News and voting in lockstep with MAGA republicans to keep the war churning. We need a real working class champion to challenge him. And although he isn’t up for re-election until 2028, we know that it will be an uphill battle. That’s why we started laying the groundwork back in November. And it’s why we need to drum up as much support as we can now in order to build a movement that’s strong enough to vote him out. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , Al Jazeera, March 12, 2026 2\. , New York Times , March 8, 2026 3\. , PBS News , March 10, 2026 4\. , Iran War Cost Tracker , March 12, 2026 5\. , Reuters , March 1, 2026 Thoughts? I’m committed to ensuring that every Virginian has access to a safe, affordable home.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127197227/607255289/1826391520?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODUzZDk4Y2QtM2ExZS1mMTExLTlhNDgtMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_N1fbwe02y3fVa0OEjwDnI976de4dqUJCLjiwuL68UU=&emci=a2cb9ba2-251e-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=853d98cd-3a1e-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=8470899)

| Hi Peter,

Housing affordability is one of the most pressing issues for Virginia families right now. I hear it from parents trying to find a safe home for their kids, from young people who are working hard but struggling to make rent, and from seniors who are being priced out of the places they’ve called home for decades.

**As Governor, I've made affordable housing a cornerstone of my agenda. I’m committed to ensuring that every Virginian has access to a safe, affordable home.**

This year, we’ve already worked to expand affordable housing programs, increase funding for low-income housing, and take action on the rising cost of living – but we know this fight isn’t over.

There’s still more work to be done to ensure every Virginian has the stability of a home they can afford. I will continue to work with local leaders and communities to make sure affordable housing remains a priority in Virginia.

**If you believe in making Virginia a place where everyone has access to safe, affordable housing, will you keep up-to-date with what my administration is doing to lower costs for Virginians by following us on social media?**

# Chubb leads Hormuz shipping insurance effort
Chubb has emerged as the lead underwriter for a U.S. government-backed reinsurance program to cover tankers in the Persian Gulf amid the Iran war, with the $20 billion initiative **[aiming to restart stalled oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.](https://substack.com/redirect/068aa920-2f1d-4262-84ce-6220cc01003a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/068aa920-2f1d-4262-84ce-6220cc01003a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Chubb leads underwriting:** U.S. insurer Chubb is the primary underwriter for the DFC's $20 billion reinsurance program covering hull, cargo, and environmental risks in the Gulf.
* **Coverage details released:** Program provides up to $20 billion in rolling coverage for war-related damages to ships and cargo transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
* **Oil prices remain high:** Brent crude trading above $91 per barrel despite the insurance program as tanker crews still refuse to sail through the conflict zone.
* **Military escort needed:** Insurance addresses financial risks but crew safety concerns require U.S. Navy protection to fully resume commercial traffic.

# **[The 1970s Called. Stagflation Is Back. Gold Went Up 2,000% Last Time.](https://substack.com/redirect/0afc0d42-7336-4119-82f1-149ef2d411c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The last time America faced stagflation -- inflation running hot while the economy slowed -- it was the 1970s. Gold went up over 2,000%.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0afc0d42-7336-4119-82f1-149ef2d411c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's what's happening right now: U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz -- the chokepoint for 20% of the world's oil. Brent crude spiked 13% in a single session. Oil is now up roughly 74% in three weeks.
The Fed is now trapped. Cut rates and inflation accelerates. Hold rates and the economy slows. That's the stagflation box -- and it's exactly the environment gold was built for.
The S&P 500 is negative on the year. Gold is up 22%. JPMorgan's 2026 target is $6,300, with an upside case of $8,500 if the conflict prolongs.
Most retirement accounts are 95%+ in stocks and bonds -- the two assets hit hardest when inflation and slow growth arrive together.

# Trump to release 172M barrels from SPR
President Trump announced **[the U.S. will release 172 million barrels](https://substack.com/redirect/edadc707-cfc6-42be-9806-0cd4a2fb33a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve over 120 days to lower domestic energy costs, with deliveries starting next week amid the Iran war's supply disruptions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/edadc707-cfc6-42be-9806-0cd4a2fb33a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Release timeline detailed:** The U.S. will start releasing oil from the reserve next week but full delivery will take about 120 days according to Energy Secretary Chris Wright.
* **Current reserve levels:** The U.S. strategic petroleum reserve currently holds 415 million barrels representing about 58 percent of its authorized 714 million barrel capacity.
* **Replacement plan outlined:** Wright said the administration will replace the released oil with 200 million barrels within the next year at no cost to taxpayers.
* **Gas prices surge:** Average U.S. gasoline prices have risen to $3.58 per gallon up 22 percent from $2.94 last month due to the supply disruption.

* * *
* * *
# Oil prices jump on Iran threats
Oil prices surged after Iran's new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei **[declared the Strait of Hormuz must remain closed,](https://substack.com/redirect/88391a55-d8cc-4402-a6a9-86f34880fe33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/88391a55-d8cc-4402-a6a9-86f34880fe33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)with markets doubting the IEA's 400 million barrel reserve release will provide meaningful relief.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/88391a55-d8cc-4402-a6a9-86f34880fe33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Hormuz closure reaffirmed:** Iran's new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei stated the Strait must remain shut to pressure the U.S. despite ongoing attacks.
* **IEA release doubted:** Markets express skepticism that the record 400 million barrel IEA reserve release will lower prices significantly.
* **Brent above $99:** Brent crude futures rose 8.71% to $99.99 per barrel as WTI climbed 9.13% to $95.22.
* **Supply gap persists:** The release covers only up to a quarter of the current daily supply shortfall from the Strait closure.

* * *
* * *
# Netflix pays $600M for Affleck AI
Netflix is **[acquiring Ben Affleck's AI moviemaking company](https://substack.com/redirect/0fe4bc31-10ec-46b7-9d36-98eebb21256b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** InterPositive for up to $600 million, marking one of the largest AI deals by a Hollywood studio as it seeks to integrate artificial intelligence in filmmaking.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0fe4bc31-10ec-46b7-9d36-98eebb21256b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Deal value disclosed:** Netflix will pay as much as $600 million for the acquisition with additional earnings tied to performance targets.
* **AI tools integration:** InterPositive's technology allows filmmakers to modify existing footage like removing items or changing backgrounds.
* **Hollywood AI adoption:** The deal highlights growing use of AI by studios to reduce production costs and enhance content creation.
* **Job loss concerns:** Industry worries include potential employment impacts and unauthorized use of creative work for AI training.

* * *
* * *
# Stryker hit by Iran-linked cyberattack
Medical device company Stryker **[suffered a global network disruption from a cyberattack](https://substack.com/redirect/44bd9578-7340-4ae5-b81d-253da9e1dc70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** possibly linked to a pro-Iranian group, affecting employee access to Microsoft systems and leading to a 3.59% stock drop.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/44bd9578-7340-4ae5-b81d-253da9e1dc70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Network disruption reported:** Stryker experienced global outage to Microsoft suite starting Wednesday, with no ransomware or malware found.
* **Pro-Iran group claims:** Hacktivist group alleged the attack, claiming to affect 200,000 systems and extract 50 terabytes of data.
* **Stock price impact:** Stryker shares fell 3.59% to $345.78 following the cyber incident announcement.
* **Similar attacks noted:** Same group claimed a breach of Verifone, though the company denied any disruption.

* * *
* * *
# Gold stagnant amid Iran conflict
Gold prices **[have remained largely unmoved](https://substack.com/redirect/2f3533e2-f1c7-4f44-92e4-0d5b053fe894?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since the Iran conflict began despite initial surges, with markets now forecasting potential rises to $6,300 per ounce by end-2026 if tensions persist.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2f3533e2-f1c7-4f44-92e4-0d5b053fe894?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Initial price surge:** Gold rose from $5,296 to $5,423 per ounce after U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran began.
* **Recent price drop:** The metal fell over 6% to $5,085 by March 3 and now trades at $5,175 per ounce.
* **Bank forecasts bullish:** J.P. Morgan predicts $6,300 per ounce by end-2026, while Deutsche Bank targets $6,000.
* **Factors suppressing gains:** Stronger U.S. dollar and higher yields offset safe-haven demand from the conflict.

* * *
* * *
# Google sells Fiber stake
Google has **[sold a partial stake in GFiber](https://substack.com/redirect/5a5004da-b55b-49b8-bc63-052be5aceb38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and will become a minority owner in the new independent venture formed with Astound Broadband, with Stonepeak as majority owner, to accelerate high-speed internet expansion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5a5004da-b55b-49b8-bc63-052be5aceb38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **New venture formed:** GFiber combines with Astound Broadband in a new entity majority-owned by investment firm Stonepeak.
* **Google minority owner:** Alphabet retains partial stake but steps back from day-to-day operations.
* **Leadership continuity:** Existing GFiber executive team including CEO Dinni Jain will lead the new company.
* **Expansion focus:** Deal aims to enable nationwide growth in high-speed fiber internet services.

Team: The Trump administration has subpoenaed records related to the 2020 election in Maricopa County, which is Arizona's largest county.
The move comes just six weeks after the FBI raided an elections office outside Atlanta, seizing records related to the 2020 presidential election. This is because Trump and his cronies continue to spread debunked conspiracy theories about voter fraud in that election.
Arizona’s Maricopa County — like Georgia’s Fulton County — has long been a centerpiece of those conspiracy theories, with opponents of voting rights alleging widespread fraud in the 2020 election without evidence , even after multiple taxpayer-funded state investigations have found nothing.
Trump's MAGA DOJ is partly doing this to salve Trump's wounded ego over his 2020 loss. But they are also doing this to scare eligible voters away from participating in the crucial 2026 midterm elections.

Trump has repeatedly threatened to “nationalize” elections ahead of the 2026 midterms, despite the fact that the Constitution explicitly delegates election administration duties to the states.
Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes had a strong response:
“ What the Trump administration appears to be pursuing now is not a legitimate law enforcement inquiry ,” Mayes said. “ It is the weaponization of federal law enforcement in service of crackpots and lies. ”
The "why" is patently clear -- make as many threats as possible in purple states and key districts to scare off eligible voters and suppress them before they even try and take part in the ballot process.

subject: Senate races keep getting pricier

# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=5259%2E35263%2En5_w4R)
Peter, we won’t sugarcoat it: Senate races are getting more expensive, and that reality matters now more than ever. The recent Texas elections topped $125 million in spending for the Senate primary alone across Republican and Democratic contests. _That’s a new record._ And things aren’t just bigger in Texas — Senate campaigns have _doubled_ every time Tammy has run. That kind of spending makes our grassroots organizing more important than ever. Big money buys visibility, but it cannot replace the relationships we build door to door, on the phones, and at kitchen tables across Wisconsin. Tammy will spend the months until Election Day not only defending our state, but helping elect Democrats in the critical seats that will decide control of the Senate. When the cost to defend Wisconsin and flip the Senate keeps rising, the only thing that beats big money is a strong grassroots base built by people like you. Organizers on the ground, targeted voter contact, and the digital tools that let our volunteers cut through the noise paid ads create — all of that is thanks to you. name: David Hogg
subject: Meet Claire Valdez and Nate Blouin
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Claire Valdez and Nate Blouin are the leaders we deserve that will meet this moment with the courage and integrity it demands.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260312-1-b&t=1&akid=3240%2E587540%2E-vYvU9)
Peter, I’m so excited to share our latest endorsements with you:
**Leaders We Deserve is officially endorsing Claire Valdez for NY-07 and Nate Blouin for UT-01!**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260312_1_endorsements.ltv97T&refcode=em20260312-3240-b&t=2&akid=3240%2E587540%2E-vYvU9)
The future of the Democratic Party will be built by candidates who come from working communities, fight unapologetically for working people, and refuse to be bought by billionaires and corporate PACs.
**Claire Valdez and Nate Blouin aren’t just part of that future — they’re building it right now.**
**[If you’re ready to send Claire and Nate to Congress to fight for working people, can you split a $5 donation between Leaders We Deserve and their campaigns today to help power them to victory?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260312_1_endorsements.ltv97T&refcode=em20260312-3240-b&amount=5&t=3&akid=3240%2E587540%2E-vYvU9)**
**Claire Valdez is a New York State Assemblymember and union organizer who got her start in politics fighting for workers on the shop floor.** As a member of UAW Local 2110, she helped organize her coworkers and negotiate contracts before bringing that same fighting spirit and fierce advocacy to the state legislature. In 2024, she took on the Democratic establishment machine after sexual harassment allegations surfaced against the then-incumbent — _and won the three way primary by 27 points._
In Albany, she’s introduced legislation to limit workplace surveillance, require just cause for work termination, cap regulated rent, and set stricter timeframes for landlords to return security deposits. When ConEd hiked rates by 13% and her constituents were left wondering how to afford their gas bill, she helped pass legislation requiring gas and electric companies to give 45 days notice before any rate increases. Claire Valdez is exactly who she says she is — a fighter for the working class.
Now Claire’s running for Congress in New York’s 7th District to take on the challenges facing everyday families. She’ll fight for stronger unions, more affordable housing, and universal health care — and she’ll do it as someone who has lived these struggles firsthand.
**Nate Blouin is a Utah State Senator and clean energy advocate who took on a 36 year incumbent and _won._** His very first bill as a state senator was to save the shrinking Great Salt Lake, whose disappearance would put hundreds of thousands at risk from air pollution as the drying lakebed exposes toxic dust that gets picked up by the wind and blown into the surrounding population centers. Nate has also passed landmark legislation modernizing Utah’s power grid for clean energy, and fought corruption in his own state’s attorney general’s office. Utah is growing fast, and its residents deserve a member of Congress who has spent his career fighting to protect the environment — someone with real skin in the game who will actually be around to see the world that legislation builds.
And Nate knows firsthand how difficult it can be to make ends meet. After college, he struggled under the weight of student debt and relied on SNAP benefits to get by. Those experiences shaped his unshakeable commitment to lowering costs for working families.
That’s why in Congress, he’ll fight to make housing and energy more affordable, take on big corporations and billionaires, and fight for Medicare for All. In his primary, Nate will face off with Ben McAdams — a pro-life Democrat who doesn’t represent where this district is headed (you heard me right... Nate’s opponent is a pro-life Democrat...). We can’t let him stand in the way of this movement.
**People-powered campaigns like Claire and Nate’s are the only way we’re going to break the grip billionaires and corporate PACs have on our politics.**
That means their campaigns depend on grassroots supporters like you, Peter, stepping up to help them win.
**[So, will you split a $5 donation between Leaders We Deserve, Claire, and Nate? Winning races like these means investing early in the leaders we believe in so they have the momentum to truly compete with candidates propped up by corporate money.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260312_1_endorsements.ltv97T&refcode=em20260312-3240-b&amount=5&t=4&akid=3240%2E587540%2E-vYvU9)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260312_1_endorsements.ltv97T&amount=5&refcode=em20260312-3240-b&t=23&akid=3240%2E587540%2E-vYvU9)**
Thank you for your support. **Let’s send Claire and Nate to Congress.**
With gratitude,
David Hogg

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. | | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
Tori is back on the Mountain Minute podcast! Listen [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Democrats voted along party lines to [defeat two Republican-backed bills](https://link.email.joinrmv.)—one limiting girls’ sports to biological females and another extending malpractice timelines for gender-related treatments received as minors. Meanwhile, a new Democrat proposal could ask voters to [redirect billions in TABOR refunds to public schools](https://link.email.joinrmv.), a move critics warn could eliminate refunds for about a decade while sending roughly $2 billion annually to K-12 education.

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright warned the state’s energy policies could [raise electricity prices and deter investment](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while wolf advocates are pushing [stricter rules requiring ranchers to exhaust nonlethal deterrence](https://link.email.joinrmv.) before wolves that attack livestock can be killed. In the 8th Congressional District, Democrat candidate Manny Rutinel is also facing scrutiny over past activism [calling animal agriculture a “horrific, exploitive industry,”](https://link.email.joinrmv.) comments he later said targeted the industry’s “bad apples.”
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Commentary critical of Rep. Diana DeGette warns [proposals to abolish ICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.) would remove border enforcement, while the Department of Education plans to require universities to [disclose foreign donors behind large gifts](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and contracts. Conservatives are also [criticizing Senate Majority Leader John Thune](https://link.email.joinrmv.) over a planned “show vote” on the SAVE America Act, as [analysis of the Iran conflict](https://link.email.joinrmv.) reports U.S. and Israeli strikes have destroyed thousands of Iranian targets and sharply reduced its missile capabilities.
This is your Mountain Minute for Thursday, March 12, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Before he was a congressional candidate, Manny Rutinel was calling animal agriculture “horrific”](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Manny Rutinel spent the better part of six years calling animal agriculture a “horrific, exploitive industry.”
Rutinel entered the legislature through an appointment in 2023 when Rep. Dafna Michaelson Jenet resigned from the District 32 seat. Less than two years later, he was filing paperwork for Congress.
He’s the money leader in a Democratic primary that national strategists are watching closely. Federal Election Commission filings put him at $2.5 million raised—almost as much as Republican incumbent Rep. Gabe Evans. Cook Political Report has it as a toss-up. The seat flipped once already—it could flip again, and the House majority may well come down to it.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Democrats defeat bills on girls’ sports fairness and malpractice timelines for gender treatments](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Democrats defeat girls’ sports fairness bill:** The House State, Civic, Military and Veterans Affairs Committee rejected HB26-1083, which would have limited participation in girls’ school sports to biological females, after testimony about competitive fairness and physical differences following male puberty.
* **Malpractice timeline bill for gender treatments also fails:** Lawmakers also voted down HB26-1128, a proposal allowing people who received gender-related medical treatments as minors more time as adults to file malpractice claims if long-term complications emerge.
* **Votes fall along party lines after emotional testimony:** Physicians, athletes, parents, and detransitioners testified about medical risks and fairness concerns, but both bills ultimately failed on 8–3 party-line votes in the committee.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**

**[If you don’t defend it, you don’t own it: DeGette’s open border gamble](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY TOM ANTHONY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Commentary criticizes call to abolish ICE:** A guest commentary argues that proposals attributed to Rep. Diana DeGette to abolish Immigration and Customs Enforcement would effectively remove federal border enforcement and undermine the concept of defended national boundaries.
* **Author links border policy to property rights principle:** The piece frames the debate through the idea that ownership requires defending boundaries, arguing that weakening border enforcement invites broader amnesty for the estimated millions of illegal immigrants currently in the country.
* **Argument ties immigration debate to broader governance concerns:** The commentary also points to economic and regulatory issues in Denver—such as declining restaurant licenses and falling property values in some areas—as examples of policies the author says reflect similar political priorities.

**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 10** _A Colorado Department of Agriculture manager who challenged training language in a federally tied pest survey report now faces possible discipline after an internal investigation concluded he “more likely than not” misrepresented the document._____

---
| | **A NOTE FROM CHRISSY**
---
| | **THE SAVE ACT IS VOTER SUPPRESSION**
---
As someone on the front lines trying to protect our democracy and as someone who gets deep in the weeds on legislation moving through Congress, voting NO on the SAVE Act was an easy decision for me.

I know there’s a lot of misinformation out there about this bill. Republicans, for example, call this a voter ID bill: If you have to show your ID to get a beer or rent a car, why not to vote? I agree!

But what Republicans aren’t saying is that this bill is SO much more and the net effect is that many people won’t be able to vote. Why? Because voters would need proof of citizenship to vote, which is more complicated than it sounds. If you have a passport, great. But if you’re in the 50% of the population that does not, it gets complicated. If you live in one of the five states that includes citizenship status on their drivers license (not Pennsylvania), great. But if you live in one of the 45 that do not, it gets complicated. If you have your birth certificate and a drivers license, and the names match, great. But if you’re in the 80% of women who change their last name when they get married, it gets complicated.

If you want to vote by mail, you have to include a photocopy of your ID with your ballot. And, yes, rumors that each state has to submit its voter list to the Department of Homeland Security for matching against its database are true. If President Trump, and Congressional Republicans who enable his worst instincts, get their way, the SAVE Act will be in place by this November’s elections and many people won’t be able to vote. We can’t let that happen.
---
| | **A WIN for free speech**
---
Last November, our President called me a traitor and said that I should be executed for a video I released with five of my national security colleagues to remind members of our military that their oath is to the Constitution.

**President Trump's Department of Justice tried to indict me for restating the law – but last month, they failed.**

This is a win for free speech, and I'm glad to put this distraction behind us so we can more easily focus on delivering progress for our communities here in Pennsylvania. Because no amount of intimidation will ever stop me from doing my job and what is morally right.
---
| | **New Dem affordability agenda**
---
For too many, the struggle to afford basic staples is a growing crisis in the United States. But despite President Trump’s promises to lower costs on Day One, his administration has failed to lower the cost of groceries, housing, and health care. And now that President Trump has chosen to go to war in Iran, energy costs – including what we pay at the pump – are substantially higher than when he was sworn into office 14 months ago.

Even though lowering costs is no longer a priority of President Trump or Congressional Republicans, it is for me. That’s why I've worked with my colleagues in the New Democrat Coalition to craft the **New Dem Affordability Agenda** , which lays out a commonsense roadmap to lower the cost of health care, housing, energy, family care, and everyday household goods like groceries.

I still believe our country is a place of opportunity. But you can’t focus on getting ahead when you are struggling to get by. Our new agenda is working to change that for everyone, not just the richest 1% or allies of the powerful.
---
Thank you for your support, Derek.

There's work to be done,

Chrissy

But despite President Trump’s promises to lower costs on Day One, his administration has failed to lower the cost of groceries, housing, and health care. And now that President Trump has chosen to go to war in Iran, energy costs – including what we pay at the pump – are substantially higher than when he was sworn into office 14 months ago. Even though lowering costs is no longer a priority of President Trump or Congressional Republicans, it is for me. That’s why I've worked with my colleagues in the New Democrat Coalition to craft the New Dem Affordability Agenda , which lays out a commonsense roadmap to lower the cost of health care, housing, energy, family care, and everyday household goods like groceries. But, the erasures are growing. The parks that generations of Americans have visited to learn, reflect, and connect with this country's full story are being quietly stripped of the facts that this administration finds inconvenient. Exhibits at sites as significant as Independence National Historical Park in Philadelphia have already been taken down — and more removals are reportedly underway across more than a dozen states.

AUGUSTA -- Three men were arrested and charged after police say they burglarized and damaged ATMs at two Augusta credit unions late Tuesday night and early Wednesday morning.
According to the Augusta Police Department, who issued a press statement after _The Robinson Report_ made inquiries, officers first responded at about 11 p.m. March 10 to a burglary alarm at Trademark Federal Credit Union on Edison Drive. Shortly after midnight, police were called to a second burglary alarm at Connected Credit Union on Civic Center Drive.
When officers arrived at the Civic Center Drive location, they encountered a dark-colored Toyota sedan leaving the area at a high rate of speed, police said. Officers later located the vehicle and arrested its three occupants.

Police identified the suspects as Yorman Uzcategui, Rafael Mari-Pina and Yorman Para. All three were charged with burglary and criminal mischief in connection with the incidents.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6c119df2-7018-4bb5-a6a6-a9e859d13967?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Authorities said evidence related to the crimes was seized during the investigation. The press release did not state whether any money was taken from the ATMs.
Each suspect was held at the Kennebec County Jail on $20,000 cash bail, according to police.
The department said all three were later picked up by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
Although this case ended with the men -- all Venezuelan nationals, per a source familiar with the investigation -- in the hands of federal immigration authorities, that kind of cooperation would be prevented under a Democratic proposal to restrict working with feds [backed](https://substack.com/redirect/7496e65e-3f57-4b37-8015-d10895086815?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Gov. Janet Mills (D).
If the alleged ATM banditos had been able to post bail under the new sanctuary state rules Gov. Mills has approved, they could have been gone in the wind.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: Charlie wrote this for the soul
body:
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbswly&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbswly&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbswly&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbswly&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbswly&__onlt=h)**
---

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

Friend,

When I say I will demand accountability, I mean it.

Before entering this race, I spent my career as a consumer investigative reporter. My work was always driven by one goal: fighting for people and demanding fairness on their behalf. I pushed for accountability and worked to bring justice to those who needed someone in their corner.

The investigative reporter in me has always been motivated to bring justice for everyday people, regardless of political party, and hold the powerful accountable.

Now I’m ready to take that same fight for justice to Congress.

name: Kate Rullo
subject: Bradstock Campaign Weekly Update
body:
| |
---
Dear Volunteers, **This week, our campaign enters an exciting new phase. Inspired by Alan 's experience in the FBI, we have developed a leadership structure that relies on you to drive our efforts forward.** We have studied the grassroots, neighborhood-oriented models of the Obama campaigns. These teams were empowered by field organizers who provided the training and information necessary for volunteers to engage directly with their own communities. While many of us have experience with traditional canvassing and phone banking, we believe there is a better way. Instead of knocking on strangers' doors with a script, we intend to build a community. Rather than simply stating our platform, we will ask our neighbors what they need from their government and how we can work together to make it happen. By listening to one another, we strengthen our party and **democracy itself.** In the coming days, your County Chief will contact you to discuss how you would like to be involved. I encourage you to step forward and share your talents and principles. Whether you are talking to friends, family, or neighbors, you will be fully trained and prepared to participate in whatever way feels most comfortable for you. We will also leverage technology to collect and analyze data from these interactions. This information will help us identify our strengths and weaknesses, allowing us to remain agile and data-driven as we work toward our goals. Let's get to work and flip this seat together. Thank you for being such a vital part of this team. Best, Kate Rullo Bradstock Volunteer Director

Flash forward to the 2020s: Even today, Florida has only sent a total of 12 Black representatives to Congress. And racial gerrymandering continues unabated: After the 2020 Census, Florida enacted an egregious redistricting plan that deliberately took voting power away from Black communities. In the first election held on the new maps, Rep. Al Lawson, a Black representative from the Jacksonville area, lost his seat after it was substantially redrawn.
Now, in 2026, they’re doubling down: In January, Gov. Ron DeSantis called for a special session of the Florida Legislature to enact a mid-decade redraw, over the strong opposition of his constituents. Any redraw would be entirely unnecessary. And we will be watching closely, given what has happened in Florida, for its effects on the voting power of communities of color across the state.
Every day, battles are being fought that could determine whether all Floridians truly have fair representation in their state and federal government. And every day, we’re working to support these fights by mobilizing grassroots activists on the ground in Florida and across the nation.

Yesterday, Olympia Democrats pushed Washington State off a cliff.
On a party-line vote, they passed Senate Bill 6346 — a 9.9% income tax — and sent it to Governor Bob Ferguson, who is eagerly waiting to sign it. With one stroke of a pen, Washington will become a state with an income tax for the first time in history.
Senate Republican Leader John Braun stood on that floor and said exactly what needed to be said:
**"This bill is wrong for our economy, it's wrong for our families, it's wrong for our communities, it's wrong for our state."**
John didn't just say those words. He meant them — because he's lived them.
For decades, John has run Braun Northwest, a family-owned business in Chehalis that employs 350 people and builds emergency vehicles. He knows what it takes to meet payroll, manage costs, and keep good people employed in Southwest Washington. He knows what happens when government makes it harder and more expensive to do business here. And he knows that when businesses struggle, families struggle.
Washington voters have rejected a state income tax 11 times over the past century. Democrats in Olympia chose to ignore that history — and ignore you.
They're calling this a "millionaires' tax." But John knows better. Once a state has an income tax, the question is never if it expands — only when. Today it's $1 million. Who do you think is next?
John is running for Congress in Washington's 3rd District to take this fight to Washington, D.C. — to stand up for families who are already stretched thin, for small business owners who are watching their margins disappear, and for communities across Southwest Washington who deserve a representative who actually understands what they're up against.
This is the moment to show Olympia — and the country — that Washington families are ready to fight back.
[Will you chip in $25, $50, or $100 today to support John Braun?](https://votebraun.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18b5086f5b76ceb7f0a23578b&id=b3b8773c0b&e=90b300faf9)

Team Braun

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Travis Grantham,

As many of you have been speculating, I have been called into active-duty service for the Air Force. subject: Our housing plan is live
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott WIENER FOR CONGRESS
body:
| | America is in the middle of a housing crisis – one that has been decades in the making. We simply haven’t built enough homes, and families across the country are now paying the price.

In California, we recognized the problem early and began reforming the rules that made it so difficult to build housing.

This week, I released a national housing plan to build 8 million new homes and finally start closing the housing gap.

* * *
I was sitting in the waiting room at NewsNation Tuesday night before doing a TV hit on Leland Vittert's show about this illegal war in Iran. The person speaking before me was former Fox News host Bill O'Reilly--a man I'll shamefully admit that, in my youth growing up in a Republican household, I once had some admiration for before fully realizing he was selling the Bush Administration's lies in Iraq.
And he spent the better part of his conversation with my buddy Leland bemoaning what he called the "earbuds generation" of Americans--young people who supposedly aren't interested in sacrificing for their country, who don't want to serve, who don't want to go fight in another stupid forever war in the Middle East.
Bill O'Reilly is 76 years old.
He is very much a part of what I wrote about this week: this generation of old men who are not going to be here to live with the consequences of their decisions, yet sneer down their noses at people who are sick and tired of being told the world has to work a certain way by men who have failed--generationally--to build a better America.
And that's more or less what I said to Leland when it was my time.
Leland asked me if America is a force for good in the world. I told him I want it to be.
But I'm not sure that it is today.
And here's the thing: if you truly believe that this conflict in Iran is in America's best interest, then you should be encouraging the Trump administration to go in front of Congress and get a war declaration. You should be encouraging them to speak directly to the American people and articulate why this is in our national interest.
Because if you want a generation of young men and women to rise up and serve in the armed forces--to go overseas, defend American interests, keep people safe, and fight for our freedom, all the bumper-sticker stuff you see in those Army and Air Force ads--they've got to have something to believe in.
The kids you're asking to serve need to know that when they come home, they'll be taken care of. That they'll be able to get a good-paying job. That they'll be able to buy a house, start a family, take a vacation once in a while, retire with dignity, and live that American dream that more and more people are giving up on right now.

* * *
You want to ask people to be selfless to defend their nation?
Then you've got to give them a nation worth believing in.
And Republican presidents--and frankly, far too many Democrats in my lifetime--have not done enough to protect the American dream. So people are giving up on it.
What they're sick and tired of seeing is an old, rich, powerful, well-connected class of people--let's call them what they are, the Epstein class--who protect one another. Who get away with destroying the economy, stripping people of their dignity, preying on little kids, and walking away untouched. People who know that no matter what happens in this country--good or bad--they're going to come out the other side with more money, more power, and more influence.
Meanwhile, 70% of Americans are left holding the bag, barely able to keep it all together.
Give people--especially young men who are getting absolutely crushed in this economy and who were promised so much by Donald Trump in the 2024 election--something to fight for. Give them an opportunity to succeed. Give it to young women too, to be clear.
If you want people to believe that America can be a force for good, America actually has to be a force for good.
We can't whore out our military to other countries. We can't launch illegal wars. We can't spend more money overseas blowing shit up than we spend making sure people don't go bankrupt when they get sick.
There was a reason so many people stepped up in World War I and World War II to defend this country.
And it wasn't just because of the evil we were fighting overseas.
It was because there was something here worth defending.
And I still believe there's still something worth defending in America today. I really do.
I don't think what we're doing in Iran makes any sense. But there is something here--a soul, a heart of a people in this country--that's worth fighting for, worth defending.
The problem is, a lot of people don't see it anymore. Because a lot of people don't feel it anymore.
They're giving up on their American dream. On their community. On their country.

Lately, I've found myself asking a simple question when I read the news: what am I not being shown? Not because I'm trying to "both sides" everything--but because outrage is good for clicks, and clarity usually isn't. That's why I use Ground News--the app and website that gathers over 50,000 new sources worldwide in one place so you can see how the same story is being covered across the political spectrum, for every story you get a visual breakdown of the bias, how reliable the source is and who owns the source reporting. I'm a paying user and was before they ever sponsored Endless Urgency. I reached out because tools like this make people harder to manipulate--and that matters. If you want a clearer, more complete picture of the news, I genuinely recommend it. They also highlight stories that are underreported by one side of the political spectrum in their Blindspot Feed. These are stories you could be missing in your media bubble. | | ---|---|--- I was sitting in the waiting room at NewsNation Tuesday night before doing a TV hit on Leland Vittert's show about this illegal war in Iran. The person speaking before me was former Fox News host Bill O'Reilly--a man I'll shamefully admit that, in my youth growing up in a Republican household, I once had some admiration for before fully realizing he was selling the Bush Administration's lies in Iraq. And he spent the better part of his conversation with my buddy Leland bemoaning what he called the "earbuds generation" of Americans--young people who supposedly aren't interested in sacrificing for their country, who don't want to serve, who don't want to go fight in another stupid forever war in the Middle East. Bill O'Reilly is 76 years old. He is very much a part of what I wrote about this week: this generation of old men who are not going to be here to live with the consequences of their decisions, yet sneer down their noses at people who are sick and tired of being told the world has to work a certain way by men who have failed--generationally--to build a better America. And that's more or less what I said to Leland when it was my time. Leland asked me if America is a force for good in the world. I told him I want it to be. But I'm not sure that it is today. And here's the thing: if you truly believe that this conflict in Iran is in America's best interest, then you should be encouraging the Trump administration to go in front of Congress and get a war declaration. You should be encouraging them to speak directly to the American people and articulate why this is in our national interest. Because if you want a generation of young men and women to rise up and serve in the armed forces--to go overseas, defend American interests, keep people safe, and fight for our freedom, all the bumper-sticker stuff you see in those Army and Air Force ads--they've got to have something to believe in. The kids you're asking to serve need to know that when they come home, they'll be taken care of. That they'll be able to get a good-paying job. That they'll be able to buy a house, start a family, take a vacation once in a while, retire with dignity, and live that American dream that more and more people are giving up on right now. clean_body: and its costing Tennesseans | Friend, Marsha Blackburn has a problem. She’s more committed to carrying water for Trump’s agenda, including his unpopular war with Iran, than working on behalf of Tennesseans. The war is both unconstitutional and out of step with international law. The Trump administration broke off treaty negotiations, launched unprovoked airstrikes that killed hundreds of Iranian civilians, including children, without notifying or seeking Congress’s approval. Meanwhile, Tennesseans are paying the price. The Pentagon estimates the first six days alone cost taxpayers $11 billion, with ongoing expenses costing $1 billion per day. Oil prices and everyday costs are skyrocketing, while at least 140 American service members have been injured and seven killed , with families left in the dark about objectives or when it will all end. Back home, Tennesseans struggle with childcare, healthcare, and housing. Marsha thinks you should foot the bill for endless warfare, while solutions to improve life in Tennessee are typically dismissed out of hand with “but how do we pay for it?” A budget is a moral document that reflects our funding priorities. Every dollar we commit to a war abroad is a dollar not invested in our communities here at home. I have a plan to tackle the problems Tennesseans care about, and it's a lot cheaper than funding a war that Americans don’t want. If I had $1 billion dollars a day, I would: Eliminate the grocery tax ($750 million) Provide universal childcare ($4-5 billion) Fix our broken roads ($38 billion). On day ONE , that’s exactly what we’ll get to work on if I’m elected. Experience matters. Not just “lines on a resume” experience. I’m talking about fearless lawyering, taking on the biggest corporations—and right now, my experience matters more than ever.
For my entire career, I’ve stood up in court for working families, building bold, first-in-the-nation legal strategies to take on the biggest corporations and the Trump administration. I’ve fought for people who are scared, squeezed, and screwed over by a system rigged in favor of the wealthy.
I’m the only candidate in this race who represents people as my job, every single day.
And that experience has never been more relevant than right now. It’s about what we can do when the attorney general's office plays offense for working families by using bold, human-centered lawyering to make lives better.
This is the office where we can hold the powerful accountable, where we can stop the system that lets those with money play by a different set of rules. But it takes someone with experience and vision to lead that fight.
I’m not running for attorney general as a stepping stone. I’m running because I believe that courageous lawyering is essential to building a brighter future for my daughters—and for every community in our state. And that it’s time we use the office of the attorney general to fight back against the rigged system in favor of the wealthy and powerful.

Peter –
Today is Working Moms Day , and as a mom myself, I’ve been thinking a lot about why this fight matters so much to me.
Being a working mom changes how you see the world.
You think about the future in a different way: about the air your kids breathe, the schools they attend, the freedoms they will grow up with, and whether the systems meant to protect them are actually working.
Like so many moms, I’m balancing work, family, and the constant question in the back of my mind: What kind of world will our kids inherit?
That question is a big part of why I decided to run for Colorado Attorney General.
I want my child, and every child in Colorado, to grow up in a state where the law protects people, not powerful interests. A state where families can count on clean air and water, safe communities, and a justice system that works for everyone.
Being a mom only makes that mission more personal. Because when you’re raising a child, the stakes aren’t abstract. They’re your child’s future.
That’s the future I’m fighting for in this campaign.
If you’re able, I hope you’ll support this campaign today so we can keep building a Colorado where every family has the opportunity to thrive. Chip in here to support our campaign for Attorney General. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2603-q1-jg?refcode=260312-email]

Team, We’re now two weeks into the 2026 primaries, and I think we’re seeing something really important. Democratic turnout in last week’s Texas primary more than doubled from 2022, and more Democrats showed up than Republicans. More Democrats than Republicans. In Texas. In North Carolina, 200,000 more Democrats voted in the Senate primary than Republicans. And just yesterday, Democrats flipped a state house seat in New Hampshire. That's ten seats we've flipped since Trump took office last year. Republicans? They’ve flipped zero. Now, you can look at those numbers and say it's just a reaction to Trump’s utter lawlessness. And yes, voters are disgusted that he’s killing protesters in Minnesota, protecting pedophiles, and started an illegal war with Iran. But I think there’s actually something deeper. Voters are telling us what kind of Democrats they want. They want people who will actually stand up to this administration — not just give a good speech about it, but fight. And they want a new generation of leaders who are going to talk to them like adults, not preach down to them about what they should think. That's what Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger, New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill, and New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani showed us last year. subject: My new challenger was an ICE prosecutor
body:

Peter, we just
learned that a former prosecutor for ICE is launching a campaign to run
against me here in Minneapolis.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260312-movement.r1ms0C&refcode=em20260312-2027&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2027%2E342411%2ES1NCac ]This is a major development in the race, and I’m asking you to stand
with us today by chipping in a $3 contribution to the Squad
Victory Fund.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260312-movement.r1ms0C&refcode=em20260312-2027&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=2027%2E342411%2ES1NCac ]RUSH $3 HERE

Peter, I
probably don’t have to tell you that Minneapolis has had enough of ICE.

Trump’s lawless band of thugs surged into our state and our city, stomped
all over our civil rights, racially profiled our communities, brutalized
and harassed countless Minnesotans, and murdered two of my constituents in
cold blood.

But we fought back. We successfully pushed for Kristi Noem to get fired,
we ended the ICE surge, and we continue to push to seek accountability for
ICE violence and to abolish this corrupt agency for good. In fact, I’ve
been calling for ICE to be abolished since Trump’s first term.

My new challenger can’t say the same. They signed up to be a prosecutor
for ICE in April 2025, when Trump’s disastrous and inhumane mass
deportation agenda was well underway. They even went so far to say they
were “proud” to work for ICE.

We already have a hugely important FEC fundraising deadline at the end of
the month. Now the stakes are even higher. We don’t know if this
challenger will receive the backing of corporate PACs, establishment
mega-donors, or even AIPAC. We have to be ready for anything.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260312-movement.r1ms0C&refcode=em20260312-2027&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=2027%2E342411%2ES1NCac ]Please: Chip in $3 to the Squad Victory Fund and join
our grassroots movement. I’m calling on progressives in Minneapolis and
around the country to help supercharge our campaign and make sure we can
beat this challenger and any other that comes our way.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260312-movement.r1ms0C&refcode=em20260312-2027&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=2027%2E342411%2ES1NCac ]Contribute ››

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar
